title: Multi-file repository maintenance corpus
description: Cross-language comparison of agents inspecting and modifying four new two-file repositories under public and hidden tests.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-repository success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check repository success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict repository-maintenance parity.

source_protocol.visible_files: Only the eight language-specific editable seed files across the four repositories.
source_protocol.protected_files: Checker, source printer, configuration, prompt, and attempt log are never agent-readable and remain integrity-hashed.

interpretation_boundary: The primary result is the within-iteration Parley/Python/Rust comparison under gpt-5.6-sol.
All four repository IDs, helper boundaries, requirement statements, seed sources, and public/hidden cases are new relative to iterations 001-024.
The protected source-printer output becomes measured agent context through the model session; source is not duplicated inline in the prompt.
Changed-file count and rough-token edit size are secondary maintenance metrics, not substitutes for hidden correctness or the four-condition gate.
Cross-iteration movement is descriptive only because iteration 025 changes from one-file inline source to controlled two-file repository inspection.
secondary_analysis: Report every session, repository outcome, repair, token count, elapsed time, prompt size, source size, edit size, changed-file count, integrity result, and command-protocol result.
Classify every first-check and hidden failure by unrelated repository and independent session.
Audit whether agents changed both entrypoint and helper where the requirement crosses that boundary, without making it a correctness prerequisite beyond tests.
Report exact filtered-file judgments and repair-free sensitivity if at least two Parley sessions pass all four repositories on the first check.
feature_boundary: Parley remains frozen at v0.3.155 with the exact 1,519-character skill. Only the language-neutral benchmark harness gained safe multi-file seed workspaces, one protected source-inspection command, and changed-file measurement; all earlier protocol modes remain backward compatible.
change_rule: No syntax, compiler, grammar, AST, checker, runtime, diagnostic, prompt skill, or benchmark instruction may change from iteration 025 output unless a signature recurs across unrelated new repositories and independent sessions, then passes general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability review.
instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is injected once per Parley session. The one allowed instruction-compression experiment is closed.
stop_rule: Preserve the complete result without selective reruns. If strict parity passes, preregister a larger confirmation before claiming parity. If it fails, make no same-corpus syntax or instruction change; only independently recurring general defects may enter separate design review.
